intro.title: GameCraft
intro.subtitle: The 6th GameCraft event
intro.description:
GameCraft is a game development event organized to inspire and nurture enthusiasm in those interested in game design and development. Hosted for the sixth time by Amirkabir University of Technology, this year's event aims to provide a platform for knowledge transfer and networking among game development experts and enthusiasts.
The event includes in-person workshops and presentations, and this year we are joined by speakers from some of the most prominent game development companies. After that, game creation and design will take place as a competition, and winners will be honored at the closing ceremony.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description:
The Computer Science Student Association at Amirkabir University is an independent organization dedicated to scientific and educational activities. Each year, the association hosts numerous academic and educational events at university, national, and international levels, attracting a large audience. Notable events include ACM competitions, Linux festivals, DMC data mining competitions, and AAISS artificial intelligence seminars.
One of the association's key approaches is strengthening team spirit and large-scale collaboration, helping students gain valuable experience for their professional lives. This event is no exception, with many students actively participating in the association's initiatives.

competitionParticipate.title: Steps to Register for the Competition
competitionParticipate.content: To register for the competitions, you must first go to the scientific association website (ceit-ssc.ir), and in the dashboard under the 'My Teams' section, form your team with your friends. Then return to GameCraft, select your desired team to register for the competitions, and pay the specified amount.

teamsConditions.title: Which teams can I choose?
teamsConditions.content: The required number of members for each competition is specified in its details. For registration, only teams that meet the eligibility criteria and have not yet participated in any competition will be displayed. Each team can only participate in one competition.

howToParticipate.title: How to participate?
howToParticipate.content: To participate in GameCraft, you need to register through our website during the registration period. Teams can consist of 2-5 members. After registration, you'll receive access to workshops and resources. Make sure to attend all required workshops and follow the competition guidelines.

competitionRules.title: Competition Rules
competitionRules.content: Teams must develop an original game concept. The game should be developed using the technologies and frameworks covered in the workshops. All team members must contribute to the development process. The final submission must include the game executable, source code, and documentation.

judgingCriteria.title: Judging Criteria and Prizes
judgingCriteria.content: Games will be evaluated based on creativity, technical implementation, user experience, and innovation. The judging panel consists of industry experts and academic professionals. Prizes will be awarded to the top three teams, with additional recognition for special achievements in specific categories.

submissionDeadline.title: Submission Deadline
submissionDeadline.content: The final submission deadline is October 10th, 2025. Teams must submit their complete game package by this date. Late submissions will not be accepted. Make sure to test your game thoroughly before submission and include all required documentation.
